reviews.title: Why pay a premium for Arctic or Noctua when you can buy these for a fraction of the cost?
reviews.comment: I really like these fans so far. I used to avoid this brand as I felt they were a bit of a crummy company, but lately I've been buying their fans due to the great price point, and I'm happy to say they've actually become my go-to. Why pay $30 for a single Noctua, when you can get 6 of these for the same price, that perform 90% as well? I'm not using these in a PC actually, i installed them to a custom mount i created and 3d printed for ventilation in my office. However, the air volume and static pressure are both perfectly acceptable and I would happily use these in any PC configuration, either as a case fan, CPU tower cooler fan, or even radiators. They are way quieter than I expected them to be, even when ramped up to the max. Overall I'm very happy with the performance, the overall fit and finish, and I have zero complaints whatsoever.
reviews.author: Hunter R.

reviews.title: Quality fans with Reasonable Cost!
reviews.comment: I've been buying case fans for over 40 years and when I find a brand that delivers quality with a good price point, I stick with them. These push a decent amount of air with almost no noticeable noise. The 4 pin plug also has a daisy chain option witch worked great for my latest build that only had 1 fan header on the mobo.  Keep up the good work Thermalright!

reviews.title: Best budget choice for a new case/build - not so much for an upgrade from existing 120s
reviews.comment: Fast delivery and great price. Easy install, swapped out my (3) front intake120s for these 140s and no temperature differences noted. PC seemed a little quieter.  I didn't get much value swapping them on a built system, but would definitely use these first in a new build as the "baseline"
